name: strictgen
description: One JSON Schema. Strict Rust, Go and TypeScript types and decoders that accept and reject exactly the same JSON.
author: Sahid Hossen

scripts.examples: pnpm build && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/examples.ts
scripts.examples:check: pnpm build && tsc -p scripts/tsconfig.json && node --experimental-strip-types --no-warnings scripts/examples.ts --check
